bug_semantics: An unauthenticated peer can place a truncated QUIC varint in a declared transport-parameter value. TransportParameters::read verifies only that the declared value length is present, then the MaxDatagramFrameSize and MinAckDelayDraft07 arms call fallible BufExt::get::<VarInt>() with unwrap(); an encoding whose prefix promises more bytes than that value contains returns UnexpectedEnd and panics the process-facing parser.
flaw_origin: Project-written Rust parser code introduced unchecked unwrap calls on attacker-controlled transport-parameter varints.
evidence: The advisory identifies quinn-proto <0.11.14 and reports the network-reachable panic at transport_parameters.rs:473, the MaxDatagramFrameSize unwrap in tag quinn-proto-0.11.13.

Commit 0837b5b51ea173f22b59deba13c4a4a6b3e688b9 first adds the MaxDatagramFrameSize parser arm and exact r.get().unwrap() line; exact-tree inspection finds that line absent from immediate parent 148bcdff5f1ba74061be3f0277013d44f3f5b776 and present in the commit.

The second fixed panic arm, MinAckDelayDraft07, was independently introduced by bab7b0af9105d274a77b945c5932f4ec1e97a9dc; its exact unwrap line is absent from immediate parent 0ae7c60b15637d7343410ba1e5cc3151e3814557 and present in the commit.
Commit af4f29b8455590652c559fce1e923363ce8fae5a only replaces numeric transport-parameter IDs with an enum while preserving both unwrap calls, so it is a refactor rather than a BIC.

Direct release-branch fix c8eefa07e087b06d8f2b78ff262ce8ac952994f1 changes both parser arms from r.get().unwrap() to r.get()?, propagating UnexpectedEnd as the parser's malformed-input error; mainline equivalent 655a8ad094e4fad463c90c4666c62db7de56384b applies the same two-line semantic fix.

Tag quinn-proto-0.11.13 contains both BICs and excludes c8eefa07e087b06d8f2b78ff262ce8ac952994f1; tag quinn-proto-0.11.14 contains both BICs and that direct fix, matching the advisory's fixed release boundary.

The primary BIC is a single-parent 2019 commit authored by Benjamin Saunders and committed by Dirkjan Ochtman; its raw commit metadata has no Co-Authored-By, generated-by, assistant, model, or other AI marker. The secondary 2023 BIC is authored by Adolfo Ochagavia, says Sponsored by Stormshield, and likewise has no AI marker.
reasoning: The advisory's observed sink is the MaxDatagramFrameSize unwrap, whose smallest public first writer is 0837b5b51ea173f22b59deba13c4a4a6b3e688b9, not the later enum refactor. Its immediate parent proves absence, and the direct fix replaces the panic with ordinary error propagation. The sibling MinAckDelayDraft07 panic closes independently to a second human-authored BIC and the same fix. The primary causal writer dates to 2019 and carries only named human author/committer metadata with no AI provenance signal; therefore this real vulnerability is NOT_AI.
